records.title: FedALT: Federated Fine-Tuning through Adaptive Local Training with Rest-of-the-World LoRA
records.reason: FedALT changes federated LoRA fine-tuning to improve cross-client personalization; the reported goal is adaptation quality and training efficiency, not LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Accurate INT8 Training Through Dynamic Block-Level Fallback
records.reason: Fallback Quantization targets INT8 pretraining/fine-tuning and reports an end-to-end training speedup on RTX 4090; the measured efficiency is training-time.

records.title: A Review and Experimental Evaluation on Split Learning
records.reason: This paper surveys and benchmarks split-learning paradigms on decentralized devices and common datasets; it is collaborative training-system evaluation, not LLM serving.

records.title: LLMaaS: Serving Large-Language Models on Trusted Serverless Computing Platforms
records.reason: Primary full text could not be retrieved from the DOI endpoint, and the available abstract does not demonstrate an in-scope inference-efficiency contribution; borderline pending verifiable full-text evidence.

records.title: Opportunities and Challenges of Generative-AI in Finance
records.reason: The paper surveys generative-AI opportunities and challenges in finance applications; it does not evaluate an inference or serving optimization.
